current_fact.zh: B-8 standalone 已停止升级，clean R1 不授权。旧共享 P0 仍是 SUPPORT_INSUFFICIENT_METHOD_INCONCLUSIVE + PROVENANCE_INCONCLUSIVE，不得改写成旧方法 FAIL。后续 CPU-only failure diagnosis 解释了“为什么原理看起来成立但 gate 学不出来”：retrieved vs token-matched placebo 的 first-divergence 在 nonzero effect 中显著更早；同物理 RTX3090 regeneration 对 11 个原 nonzero unit 的首分叉位置 11/11 复现、具体首分叉 action pair 10/11 复现，排除了纯随机噪声。但 state-signature localization 很弱（相对最佳 task baseline Brier 仅改善 3.46%，MI permutation p=0.216）；同一 memory se-m-pick_cool_then_place_in_recep-1 在完全相同的 index-0 pre_acquire|navigate>navigate signature 下对 cool/heat/clean target 分别产生 -1/+1/-1。当前最符合的解释是：memory 稳定地改变早期 trajectory branch，但最终 benefit/harm sign 由 downstream context 放大决定；因此 candidate-global replicated-effect 假设过强。该诊断不复活 B-8，也不自动授权替代 idea。 工程上仅保留为 soft audit-priority signal：1-step 约 25% paired-rollout 成本可覆盖 54.5% nonzero effects，但达到 90.9% recall 时 5-step 成本已约 90.1%；因此只能用于审计排序，禁止作为 hard gate 淘汰 confirmatory cases。
current_fact.en: Standalone B-8 escalation is stopped and a clean R1 is not authorized. The old shared P0 remains SUPPORT_INSUFFICIENT_METHOD_INCONCLUSIVE plus PROVENANCE_INCONCLUSIVE and must not be rewritten as an old-method FAIL. A later CPU-only failure diagnosis explains why the principle can look right while the gate remains unlearnable: retrieved versus token-matched placebo diverges significantly earlier on nonzero-effect units. On matched physical RTX3090 regeneration, the first-divergence index reproduces for 11/11 original nonzero units and the exact first-divergent action pair for 10/11, ruling out pure stochastic noise. Yet state-signature localization is weak (only 3.46% Brier improvement over the best task baseline; MI permutation p=0.216). The same memory se-m-pick_cool_then_place_in_recep-1 yields -1/+1/-1 on cool/heat/clean targets under the identical index-0 pre_acquire|navigate>navigate signature. The best current explanation is reproducible early trajectory-branch steering whose downstream context determines benefit versus harm, so the candidate-global replicated-effect assumption was too strong. This diagnosis does not revive B-8 or auto-authorize a replacement idea. Operationally, retain this only as a soft audit-priority signal: a 1-step screen uses about 25% of paired-rollout cost and captures 54.5% of nonzero effects, but reaching 90.9% recall at 5 steps already costs about 90.1%. It may prioritize audit order but must never hard-exclude confirmatory cases.

current_fact.zh: B-9 standalone 已停止，strict-LOTO 仅保留为 archived secondary diagnostic。旧结果仍是 TRANSPORT_SUPPORT_INSUFFICIENT，不是方法 FAIL。后续 first-divergence diagnosis 进一步表明，memory effect 的可复现部分主要是“早期 trajectory branch 被稳定改变”，而不是可由 local state/task signature 稳定预测的最终 effect sign：11 个 nonzero unit 的同卡 regeneration 首分叉位置 11/11 复现、action pair 10/11 复现，但完全相同的早期 signature 可在不同 target context 下翻转 sign。因而 B-9 的 task-level effect transport 假设也过强；当前不授权 clean R1、formal-method、第二 backbone 或自动替代 idea。 工程上仅保留为 soft audit-priority signal：1-step 约 25% paired-rollout 成本可覆盖 54.5% nonzero effects，但达到 90.9% recall 时 5-step 成本已约 90.1%；因此只能用于审计排序，禁止作为 hard gate 淘汰 confirmatory cases。
current_fact.en: Standalone B-9 is stopped; strict LOTO remains only as an archived secondary diagnostic. The old result remains TRANSPORT_SUPPORT_INSUFFICIENT, not a method FAIL. The later first-divergence diagnosis shows that the reproducible component of memory effect is mainly stable early trajectory-branch steering rather than a final effect sign that is stable under local-state or task signatures: matched-hardware regeneration reproduces the first-divergence index for 11/11 nonzero units and the action pair for 10/11, while an identical early signature can flip sign across downstream target contexts. The task-level effect-transport assumption was therefore also too strong. Clean R1, formal-method work, a second backbone, and automatic replacement-idea creation remain unauthorized. Operationally, retain this only as a soft audit-priority signal: a 1-step screen uses about 25% of paired-rollout cost and captures 54.5% of nonzero effects, but reaching 90.9% recall at 5 steps already costs about 90.1%. It may prioritize audit order but must never hard-exclude confirmatory cases.

title.zh: 限探针 API 转移算子

current_fact.zh: E-3 已完成两层 P0：先在 GitLab/Codeberg 无泄漏 read-only reality P0 上 deterministic P/E/X 12/12；随后补 stateful side-effect/recovery harness，ledger/vault 两个不同状态码 family 各 N=6 probes，hidden create/update/delete、duplicate，以及跨操作的 stale-update→hidden stale-delete、missing-delete→hidden missing-update，共 12/12 final-state + recovery 精确。read-only 与 state-changing E 两层都被同构 deterministic P/E/X ceiling，触发 STOP_STATEFUL_DETERMINISTIC_PEX_CEILING；learned arm 不再运行，等待人工 DROP/merge。
current_fact.en: E-3 completed two P0 layers: first a leakage-free read-only reality P0 on GitLab/Codeberg where deterministic P/E/X scored 12/12; then a stateful side-effect/recovery harness with ledger/vault as two distinct status-code families, N=6 probes each, and hidden create/update/delete, duplicate, plus cross-operation stale-update→hidden stale-delete and missing-delete→hidden missing-update cases. The deterministic isomorphic P/E/X baseline again achieved 12/12 exact final-state plus recovery semantics. Both read-only and state-changing E layers are at ceiling, firing STOP_STATEFUL_DETERMINISTIC_PEX_CEILING; the learned arm is not run and E-3 awaits human DROP/merge review.

title.zh: 固定上限下的干预式权限重授权筛选
title.en: Interventional Permission Triage Under a Fixed Ceiling

current_fact.zh: E-4 executable permission CPU P0 已收口：在 train/test mutation feature combinations 0 重叠的 32 个 unseen operators 上，线性 q 虽以 0 missed-risk 将重授权从 deterministic envelope 的 72 降到 53，但同一 mutation representation + 同一 intervention labels 的 monotone-DNF 简单规则同样 0 missed-risk，只需 29 次重授权。触发 STOP_MATCHED_BOOLEAN_RULE_EQUIVALENT；learned q 独立机制不再保留，等待人工 DROP/merge。
current_fact.en: E-4 executable-permission CPU P0 is closed: on 32 unseen operators with zero overlap between train and test mutation feature combinations, the linear q reduces reauthorizations from 72 for the deterministic envelope to 53 at zero missed risk, but a monotone-DNF simplification induced from the identical mutation representation and intervention labels also has zero missed risk and needs only 29 reauthorizations. STOP_MATCHED_BOOLEAN_RULE_EQUIVALENT fires; the learned-q mechanism is not retained as a standalone method and awaits human DROP/merge review.

title.zh: 约束完备的类型化记忆顺序逻辑

current_fact.zh: CPU P0 已触发预注册 STOP：32 个全部含有效约束的 held-out 类型组合上，symbolic 与匹配 typed n-ary factor 的 exact accuracy 均为 1.00；将 factor 编译控制限制到与 symbolic 相同 active-edge budget 后，compiled accuracy 仍 1.00 vs 1.00，平均 edge checks 同为 1.125。独立符号表征/编译优势均被 matched simplification 复现，不建议再耗 GPU；等待人工确认 DROP/merge。
current_fact.en: CPU P0 fired the preregistered STOP. Across 32 held-out type combinations with binding constraints, symbolic and matched typed n-ary factor exact accuracy are both 1.00; after matching the factor compiled control to the same active-edge budget, compiled accuracy remains 1.00 vs 1.00 with identical 1.125 mean edge checks. Both standalone symbolic-representation and compilation advantages are reproduced by the matched simplification, so no GPU expansion is recommended; await human DROP/merge review.

current_fact.zh: CPU P0 已触发 matched-simplification STOP：24 个冻结 4–8-update 稀疏故障案例上，active-causal 与非学习 binary group testing 均 100% 找到最小故障集，平均测试次数逐 case 完全一致（5.708 vs 5.708，paired p=1.0）。相对 ddmin 的 62% 节省来自换成了更适合稀疏故障的标准 group testing，而不是独立学习机制；不建议再耗真实序列/GPU，等待人工确认 DROP/merge。
current_fact.en: CPU P0 fired a matched-simplification STOP. Across 24 frozen 4–8-update sparse-fault cases, active-causal and non-learning binary group testing both recover the exact minimal fault set on 100% of cases with identical per-case intervention counts (5.708 vs 5.708 mean tests, paired p=1.0). The apparent 62% saving over ddmin comes from switching to standard sparse group testing rather than a distinct learned mechanism; no real-sequence/GPU expansion is recommended, pending human DROP/merge review.

title.zh: 反事实进化决策控制器

current_fact.zh: A-7 CPU same-state four-action P0 已触发 matched-simplification STOP：hidden table 中 continue/commit/rollback/stop 分别有 6/2/6/2 个最优动作，线性 counterfactual controller 16/16、mean/worst regret=0；但仅用同四个原始 state features、由 train/calibration 选择的 depth-3 CART（13 nodes）同样 16/16、regret=0，四动作分布完全一致。counterfactual table 仍可作为 A-2 的诊断/简单决策规则，但 standalone learned-controller 主张被浅规则完全复现，不建议再做真实四动作 GPU replay，等待人工确认 merge/drop。
current_fact.en: A-7 CPU same-state four-action P0 fired a matched-simplification STOP. The hidden table supports all actions with optimal counts continue/commit/rollback/stop = 6/2/6/2. The linear counterfactual controller reaches 16/16 with zero mean/worst regret, but a depth-3 CART with only the same four raw state features, selected using train/calibration only, also reaches 16/16 and zero regret with the identical action distribution. The counterfactual table remains useful as A-2 diagnostic/simple decision-rule evidence, but the standalone learned-controller claim is fully reproduced by a shallow rule; no real four-action GPU replay is recommended pending human merge/drop review.

future-learnability-preserving-self-evol.paper_problem: A persistent update may preserve current reward and old-task retention yet reduce the agent's capacity to learn the next task efficiently.
future-learnability-preserving-self-evol.novelty_boundary: Retention/capability preservation protects current or old behavior; this paper treats future adaptation capacity as a separate update-admission quantity.

final_parent_mechanism.en: Probe candidate updates with an identical sealed second-stage adaptation budget and gate commits using future-adaptation AUC after matching current gain and retention.
final_parent_mechanism.zh: Probe candidate updates with an identical sealed second-stage adaptation budget and gate commits using future-adaptation AUC after matching current gain and retention.

strongest_baseline.en: Current-gain + retention gate with the same candidate updates, tasks, model calls, and second-stage adaptation budget.
strongest_baseline.zh: Current-gain + retention gate with the same candidate updates, tasks, model calls, and second-stage adaptation budget.

minimum_p0.en: Find matched candidate-update pairs with similar current/retention performance, then compare future-adaptation AUC and improvement-per-example on sealed task families.
minimum_p0.zh: Find matched candidate-update pairs with similar current/retention performance, then compare future-adaptation AUC and improvement-per-example on sealed task families.

exact_stop.en: Stop the standalone method if future-learnability deltas vanish after matching current gain/retention or are fully predicted by those quantities.
exact_stop.zh: Stop the standalone method if future-learnability deltas vanish after matching current gain/retention or are fully predicted by those quantities.

substrate_inventory.target_variation_rule: at least two matched update pairs with nonzero future-adaptation delta

economy_contract.effect_observable: future adaptation AUC / improvement-per-example after matching current gain and retention
economy_contract.effect_moderators: task family; initial update; baseline current success; retention delta
economy_contract.effect_stability_scope: Qwen2.5-7B local P0 only; second model locked
economy_contract.aggregation_risk: family-level cancellation can hide update-specific plasticity debt; report per-update and per-family before macro averaging
economy_contract.cheapest_falsifier: four initial updates, matched current/retention probes, one identical bounded second-stage adaptation, sealed future probes
economy_contract.decision_changing_outcomes: nonzero future-learnability separation at matched current/retention vs no separation
economy_contract.abandonment_condition: no matched pairs or future-adaptation effect collapses to current/retention predictors

title.en: Causal Routing Across Agent Update Surfaces

current_fact.zh: 经 Paper-first novelty premortem 与用户明确授权进入 P0 lifecycle。当前只授权局部 F0/P0-Support 资格验证；方法结论、扩预算、第二 backbone 与 full experiment 均保持锁定，必须经过 Economy、Updater/Support、Pre-Experiment 8/8 与 Method Freeze。
current_fact.en: Promoted into the P0 lifecycle after the paper-first novelty premortem and explicit user authorization. Only local F0/P0-Support qualification is currently authorized; method conclusions, budget expansion, a second backbone, and full experiments remain locked behind Economy, updater/support qualification, Pre-Experiment 8/8, and Method Freeze.

cross-surface-repair-routing.paper_problem: The same observed failure may be repaired at prompt/memory, workflow, tool/code, or weights, but most systems choose the update surface before causal evidence is collected.
cross-surface-repair-routing.novelty_boundary: Existing localization work searches edits inside a chosen workflow/source surface; this problem is upstream ownership selection across persistent update surfaces.

final_parent_mechanism.en: Run same-information minimal interventions on declared repair surfaces, estimate causal repair benefit/collateral regression/cost, and route to the smallest sufficient surface.
final_parent_mechanism.zh: Run same-information minimal interventions on declared repair surfaces, estimate causal repair benefit/collateral regression/cost, and route to the smallest sufficient surface.

strongest_baseline.en: Best fixed surface and same-evidence LLM surface selector, both under identical intervention and evaluation budgets.
strongest_baseline.zh: Best fixed surface and same-evidence LLM surface selector, both under identical intervention and evaluation budgets.

minimum_p0.en: Controlled prompt/workflow/tool fault table with matched repairs; require heterogeneous repair ownership and held-out advantage over fixed-surface routing.
minimum_p0.zh: Controlled prompt/workflow/tool fault table with matched repairs; require heterogeneous repair ownership and held-out advantage over fixed-surface routing.

exact_stop.en: Stop if one surface dominates all faults, ownership is recoverable from trivial metadata, or a same-evidence simple selector matches the router.
exact_stop.zh: Stop if one surface dominates all faults, ownership is recoverable from trivial metadata, or a same-evidence simple selector matches the router.

substrate_inventory.target_variation_rule: at least two fault families require different minimal sufficient repair surfaces

economy_contract.effect_observable: paired success recovery, held-out transfer, collateral regression, and intervention cost
economy_contract.effect_moderators: fault family; task family; repair surface
economy_contract.effect_stability_scope: controlled ALFWorld local P0; natural-failure validation required before paper claim
economy_contract.aggregation_risk: oracle injected ownership can make routing trivial; metadata is hidden and outcome-only identification is required
economy_contract.cheapest_falsifier: three fault families x three repair surfaces on a small held-out ALFWorld task set
economy_contract.decision_changing_outcomes: heterogeneous minimal-surface ownership plus outcome-based routing headroom vs fixed/simple baselines
economy_contract.abandonment_condition: single-surface dominance or no outcome-identifiable ownership

current_fact.en: Promoted into the P0 lifecycle after the paper-first novelty premortem and explicit user authorization. diagnosability-preserving-self-evolution.paper_problem: An update can improve task success while making later failures harder to localize by erasing trace distinctions or provenance signals.
diagnosability-preserving-self-evolution.novelty_boundary: Observability is commonly used to improve the harness; this work treats diagnosability itself as a post-update invariant that can veto a commit.

final_parent_mechanism.en: Use sealed failure probes and a frozen external cause observer; commit only if task utility improves without degrading failure-cause separability/provenance coverage.
final_parent_mechanism.zh: Use sealed failure probes and a frozen external cause observer; commit only if task utility improves without degrading failure-cause separability/provenance coverage.

strongest_baseline.en: Task regression + trace completeness and observability-only optimization under the same probes.
strongest_baseline.zh: Task regression + trace completeness and observability-only optimization under the same probes.

minimum_p0.en: Use the shared controlled-fault table to freeze a simple diagnostic observer on development tasks and test post-update cause localization on held-out tasks.
minimum_p0.zh: Use the shared controlled-fault table to freeze a simple diagnostic observer on development tasks and test post-update cause localization on held-out tasks.

exact_stop.en: Stop if diagnosability changes are fully explained by trace length/completeness or do not predict downstream repair cost/accuracy.
exact_stop.zh: Stop if diagnosability changes are fully explained by trace length/completeness or do not predict downstream repair cost/accuracy.

substrate_inventory.target_variation_rule: at least three fault causes with nontrivial diagnostic separability

economy_contract.causal_unit: candidate-update x sealed diagnostic fault probe
economy_contract.prediction_unit: candidate-update x sealed diagnostic fault probe
economy_contract.effect_observable: frozen-observer cause localization accuracy/AUROC and provenance coverage at matched task utility
economy_contract.effect_moderators: fault cause; update surface; task family
economy_contract.aggregation_risk: successful repair can remove the original fault signature; diagnosability is measured on independent sealed fault probes after the update
economy_contract.cheapest_falsifier: reuse PF-2 collection and evaluate a frozen simple observer before/after candidate updates
economy_contract.decision_changing_outcomes: utility-matched updates with reproducibly different diagnostic separability vs trace-completeness baseline
economy_contract.abandonment_condition: no diagnostic variation beyond trace completeness or no relation to future repair difficulty

failure-mode-transport-under-self-evolut.paper_problem: Aggregate success can improve while residual failure probability moves toward more silent, severe, or unrecoverable modes.
failure-mode-transport-under-self-evolut.novelty_boundary: Static failure taxonomies and aggregate regression do not measure paired longitudinal movement of failure probability mass under a persistent update.

final_parent_mechanism.en: Estimate a paired before/after Failure Transport Matrix over preregistered failure classes and gate updates that substitute ordinary failures with higher-risk modes.
final_parent_mechanism.zh: Estimate a paired before/after Failure Transport Matrix over preregistered failure classes and gate updates that substitute ordinary failures with higher-risk modes.

strongest_baseline.en: Aggregate success/regression and static failure-weighted risk using the same paired tasks.
strongest_baseline.zh: Aggregate success/regression and static failure-weighted risk using the same paired tasks.

minimum_p0.en: Reuse the shared PF-2 collection; classify paired pre/post traces into preregistered failure modes and test whether equal/similar success deltas can hide different transport risk.
minimum_p0.zh: Reuse the shared PF-2 collection; classify paired pre/post traces into preregistered failure modes and test whether equal/similar success deltas can hide different transport risk.

exact_stop.en: Stop if paired transport adds no decision-relevant information beyond aggregate success/static risk or failure classes are not stable/reproducible.
exact_stop.zh: Stop if paired transport adds no decision-relevant information beyond aggregate success/static risk or failure classes are not stable/reproducible.

substrate_inventory.target_variation_rule: at least three preregistered failure classes and non-diagonal before/after transitions

economy_contract.effect_observable: failure-class transport matrix and risk-weighted transport delta
economy_contract.effect_moderators: task family; fault class; update surface
economy_contract.aggregation_risk: macro success can cancel harmful substitutions; report full transition matrix and per-class mass
economy_contract.cheapest_falsifier: reuse PF-2 paired traces and deterministic preregistered failure taxonomy
economy_contract.decision_changing_outcomes: same/similar aggregate success with materially different transport risk vs transport fully determined by aggregate success
economy_contract.abandonment_condition: no stable non-diagonal transport or transport never changes an update decision
